jobs.occupation: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 20,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

We are looking for an experienced Principal Design System Engineer to help shape and drive the continued evolution of Lighthouse Design System, 3Shape’s design system across web, mobile, and on-premises software solutions.

You will be the first dedicated Design System engineer and will be overall responsible for defining the technical direction and development of Lighthouse Design System. In this role, you will combine technical leadership, hands-on engineering, and cross-functional collaboration. Together with other colleagues, you will build a scalable foundation that enables our product teams to efficiently deliver consistent, accessible, and high-quality experiences. To achieve this, you will be balancing technical solutions with stakeholder management – staying ambitious yet pragmatic with the product. Likewise, you will be fundamental in creating followership across the broader organization, in ensuring its implementation, adaptability and recognition.

Becoming our new colleague means becoming a 3Shaper. Here we work to improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients. We do this by providing innovative 3D scanners and advanced software for dental professionals that improve dental care and patients’ lives worldwide.

Key responsibilities

• 
Champion continuous improvement in how we develop, drive and implement the Lighthouse Design System, ensuring high ambition yet pragmatic approach to the result.

• 
Creating followership, by enabling product teams to adopt, contribute to, and get value from the Lighthouse Design System.

• 
Raise the engineering bar across front-end teams, by establishing scalable engineering standards, patterns, and quality practices across web, mobile, and on-premise software solutions.

Own and mature our internal component library - balancing scalability, usability, performance, and maintainability.

• 
Partner with Product Portfolio Strategy and the Design System UX Lead, to ensure technical robustness, business impact and end-user value.

• 
Mentor and coach engineers that contribute to the Lighthouse Design System along with staying hands-on during key technical initiatives.

What are we looking for?

• 
10+ years software engineering experience, with significant experience in design system management and front-end development having held a similar principal or staff-level engineering role.

• 
Proven ability to influence technical adoption and direction for Design System adoption in an organization with many technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• 
Strong experience with Angular / TypeScript and modern front-end engineering. If you have experience working with multiple architectural design patterns across multiple tech-stacks, it is considered a plus.

• 
Strong experience with building and maintaining component libraries, design systems, or platform-like products serving multiple teams and the ability to establish clear approaches for ownership boundaries, versioning, and backwards compatibility.

• 
Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to a strong engineering culture.

• 
Experience of working closely together with designers and product managers and navigating technical trade-offs across multiple stakeholders.

• 
Experience in applying AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and developer experience, while maintaining strong technical standards and human oversight.

• 
Experience with improving developer experience through tooling, automation, documentation, or processes. To improve the way teams, contribute to and adopt the design system.

• 
A pragmatic and hands-on approach, with a passion for building simple and scalable solutions to complex problems.

We offer

• 
A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and cooperative colleagues - we are more than 40 nationalities in our DK based office.

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and a delicious, healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
We provide a great social work environment with many voluntary activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games and running to bicycle clubs.

• 
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• 
A clear, shared purpose: Help improve dental patient care on a global scale.

Get in touch now!

Please do not hesitate to apply for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest growing high-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously.

You don’t need to meet every criteria to be successful in this role. If you bring strong experience working with design systems, are excited by the opportunity to shape a design system on a large scale and can see yourself growing in the other areas then we do encourage you to apply.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. jobs.description:
**Location: Denmark / Croatia

**Do you want to work on projects that drive energy efficiency and support the global transition to sustainable solutions? Are you passionate about power electronics, converter systems, and advanced energy control? Then this opportunity at DEIF A/S might be the right fit for you.

DEIF is a global leader in power efficiency, delivering advanced control solutions that support the green transition. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we are on an ambitious growth journey, focusing on innovation, sustainability, and intelligent energy management.

**About The Role

**As an Technical Engineer, you will join our Integration Team. We develop customized solutions for power generation and energy management systems across Marine, Offshore, and land-based industries.

In this role, you will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to design and implement solutions, particularly within:

• Power electronics and converter-based systems

• Power Management Systems (PMS)

• Marine and Offshore applications

You will play an important role in delivering reliable, efficient, and tailor-made solutions that create value for our customers and organization.

**

• Analyze customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions

• Develop and implement application software for energy control systems

• Contribute to Power Management System (PMS) solutions

**

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in engineering, automation, electronics, or another relevant technical discipline, or possess equivalent technical qualifications.

• Have around 5-10 years of experience within industrial automation, robotics, or manufacturing technology.

• Bring solid experience in programmable logic controller programming, preferably with Siemens TIA Portal.

• Have experience with robotics; knowledge of KUKA and/or Fanuc is considered an advantage.

• Have participated in commissioning activities, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests, and equipment qualification processes.

• Have experience with or interest in industrial connectivity, manufacturing information technology, cloud technologies, servers, and machine control standards.

• Enjoy collaborating with diverse stakeholders and building strong working relationships across functions.

With production companies and sales operations across the world, our products are widely available, and we are committed to creating better living environments through daylight and fresh air.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX, we believe in fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive, develop, and perform at their best. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking.

We recruit, hire, develop, and promote people based on skills, qualifications, and potential. We value diversity and inclusion because we know that different perspectives help us create better solutions, stronger teams, and a more innovative workplace.

Imagine a future where you safeguard the stability and resilience of operational technology systems that underpin offshore and onshore renewable energy generation.

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

You’ll play an important role in:

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Shape the future with us

Does it excite you to work with cell-based assays to advance innovative peptide-based medicines, and do you have experience with assay automation and liquid handlers? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

**Your new position

**As Senior Laboratory Technician, you will be running cell-based assays to screen and profile candidate drugs in collaboration with other technicians and scientists in the Molecular Pharmacology department. In addition, you will also contribute to the optimization and automation of our laboratory workflows. This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant contribution to the advancement of our projects by delivering high-quality in vitro data.

**We Offer Exciting Responsibilities

**

• Conducting weekly in vitro assays to assess the efficacy of new peptide drug candidates

• Contributing to the development and improvement of laboratory workflows, with a focus on automation of cell-based assays

• Planning and execution of practical laboratory work

• Processing instrument data in specialized software and databases

• Responsibilities for maintenance of the lab and lab equipment

For further information, please contact Head of In vitro profiling and signaling, Karin Hägerbrand and KHagerbrand@zealandpharma.com.

Full-time | On-site in Søborg/Copenhagen | Visibuilt

Join Visibuilt as we take a fossil-free, fermentation-based binder from the lab to the market. We are looking for an experienced financial controller who would like to be the person keeping a growing climate-tech company financially sound, investor-ready and well organised – from the month-end close to the board pack.

Location: Søborg, Greater Copenhagen (on-site)

Start: 1 January 2027 (or as soon as possible)

Type: Full-time employment

Salary: Competitive and in line with the market, reflecting your experience and responsibilities

Reports to: CEO & Founder, Line Kloster Pedersen

Core focus: Financial control and reporting, operations, grants, board and shareholder administration, financial modelling and fundraising support

About Visibuilt

Visibuilt is building fossil-free alternatives for pavement materials. Our core technology, visiBINDER, is a 100% bio-based binder developed from mycelium and designed to reduce energy use and CO2 emissions in infrastructure materials. We are based at Alfa Laval Innovation House in Søborg, just outside Copenhagen.

The role

Visibuilt has grown from an early-stage startup into a company with institutional investors, an active board, several public grant projects and an R&D team whose decisions need solid numbers behind them. You will be our finance and administration function: the person who makes sure our numbers are accurate, on time and useful for decisions – and who owns the operational backbone of the company.

·       A broad role with real ownership. You will be our only finance person, so you plan and manage your own areas – including the operational processes that keep a growing team running – in close collaboration with the CEO, our CTO, our external accountant and payroll administration, auditors and lawyers.

·       Cash is king. You will own the cashflow budget and rolling forecast, so we always know our runway and spot pinch points well before they arrive. With several grant projects running, customer project, and heavy R&D, this means keeping a close eye on when money actually lands compared with when we spend it.

·       You oversee the bookkeeping. Our external accountant handles the day-to-day entries. Your job is to monitor, quality-check and follow up on their work, and to turn it into reporting the CEO and board can rely on.

·       Real business impact. You get to understand our business and provide market analyses for business development and cost models for R&D.

Responsibilities

Financial control

·       Monitor and quality-check invoicing, payroll and bookkeeping carried out by our external accountant (e-conomic) and approve payments together with management.

Reporting, audit & annual accounts

·       Deliver monthly finance reporting, budget-vs-actual and runway forecasts for management and the board.

·       Take responsibility for the annual accounts and the audit process with our auditors, meeting investor deadlines.

Operations ownership

·       Look after our people operations: keep the employee handbook and policies up to date, and run holiday planning and time registration.

Grant management

·       Manage our public grant portfolio (e.g. EUDP): project budgets, timesheets, reimbursement claims and progress reporting.

·       Support new grant applications with budgets and co-financing plans.

Board, shareholders & governance

·       Act as board secretary: prepare board packs, take minutes and follow up on decisions.

·       Manage shareholder matters – shareholder register, warrant programmes, general meetings, investor reporting and filings with the Danish Business Authority – with support from our lawyers. You coordinate and execute a quarterly shareholder report with the CEO.

Support for business development and R&D

·       Build market analyses (market sizing, segments, pricing) that support the CEO’s commercial work.

  Find information about the department.

  Job description
 In the consideration of applications for the professorship, the main emphasis will be on the applicant's ability to document a high level of original scientific work at an international level within the area of Otorhinolaryngology.

  The professor's responsibilities will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research, including publication/academic dissemination – The professor is expected to conduct and lead high-quality clinical and translational research within otorhinolaryngology, head and neck surgery and audiology. Relevant research areas that are prioritized will be head and neck surgical oncology and biomarker development. The professor is furthermore expected to contribute to the development and implementation of new diagnostic and treatment approaches within the field. 	
• Research-based teaching, including associated examination – The professor will contribute actively to undergraduate, postgraduate, and continuing medical education through research-based teaching. In particular, the professor is expected to contribute to teaching and examination within the Clinical Course in Otorhinolaryngology and the Medical Specialty Focused Course and Exam in Otorhinolaryngology, and to supervise medical students, PhD candidates, and clinical researchers. The professor will contribute to the integration of current research findings into clinical teaching, curriculum development, and specialist training. 	
• Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers – The professor is expected to play a central role in the development and strategic direction of the research environment within otorhinolaryngology, head and neck surgery and audiologThe professor is expected to contribute to innovation and societal impact through the development, evaluation, and implementation of new knowledge, technologies, and clinical practices. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate 	
• Academic assessments   Required qualifications 
 To be qualified for a clinical professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution, and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

  Furthermore, each applicant must be able to:

   	
• Document a high degree of original academic production at an international level, including considerable contributions to the development of the academic discipline 	
• Manage research and other management functions, e.g. engage in the university’s external academic activities, as well as knowledge and technology transfer 	
• Provide research-based teaching   The professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment 
 The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of five years. Extension is possible if the employed candidate performs well in the position.

  For the professorship the appointee will receive a pensionable annual honorarium of 219.882,33 DKK (1 August 2026 level).

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

  Questions
 For further information please contact Head of Department Nicolai W. Albrechtsen, nicolai.albrechtsen@regionh.dk.

  Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

 The application must be submitted in English and must include the following documents:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Uploads of maximum 10 publications to be considered in the assessment 	
• Self-declaration form (Template under Nyttige links - Upload the completed and mandatory form as “Other relevant material”)

• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan 	
• A complete list of publications   Application procedure 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee. When the assessment work is completed, each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
jobs.description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  
You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  
- Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life
- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health
- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education
- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation
- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches
- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation
- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination
- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities
 
The following qualifications are highly valued:  
You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  

Qualifications  
- A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field
- Experience with intervention and implementation research
- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health
- A strong profile within qualitative research
- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research
- Experience in national and international research collaboration
- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)
- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing
- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas
 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  
Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  
Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process
Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 
Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  
Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
Motivated application

• 
Curriculum vitae

• 
Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

• 
Teaching portfolio

• 
Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

• 
A complete list of publications

• 
Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

• 
Reference letters/references may also be included

• 
A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dk

Application deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  
The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  
The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Part-time Lecturer in Responsible Business Governance and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence
jobs.description:
A position as Part-time Lecturer in Responsible Business Governance and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence is available at the Department of Management, Society and Communication for appointment on 01 January 2027.

As part-time lecturer you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to educate young people and to provide them with insight into your practical experience. At CBS, part-time lecturers represent an important supplement to the teaching done by researchers. Your role as part-time lecturer will also provide you with opportunities to update your theoretical knowledge, to share in discussions with engaged students and to be part of an international academic environment.

The position is on a temporary part-time basis, which can be extended within the framework of the Danish Fixed-Term Employment Act (Lov om tidsbegrænset ansættelse).

MSC’s research and teaching addresses the dynamic relations between business and society and the responsible management thereof. To this end, MSC mobilises a wide range of knowledge within management and business disciplines as well as the broader social and human sciences, organized in three interconnected research environments: CBS Sustainability; Centre for Business and Development Studies; the Communication, Organisation and Governance Research Cluster.

The position includes 

• 
Planning and conducting teaching on responsible business governance and corporate responsibility due diligence, with a particular focus on risk management, reporting and finance between sustainability expectations and compliance. The part-time lecturer is expected to have solid knowledge of sustainability (risk-based) due diligence, international governance frameworks on responsible business conduct, EU law and policy on corporate sustainability, demands on companies, social expectations of responsible business conduct, and business uptake, responses and challenges in the interface of management and growing public regulation of responsible business and corporate sustainability.

• 
Online teaching—blended learning

• 
Student supervision

• 
Preparing teaching materials and exam questions

• 
Conducting exams and other evaluations

Qualifications

To fill this position, you have a master’s degree and:

• 
High-level practical experience at a high level, which has not been gained through academic employment with a university, or

• 
Employment in an academic principal position with another university (e.g. as assistant professor/researcher, associate professor/senior researcher, or professor/professor with special responsibilities).

• 
A part-time lecturer who is employed on the merits based on their relevant practical experience must possess in-depth, up-to-date knowledge of the possible applications of the subject/academic discipline. This knowledge is/has been acquired through employment within the subject/academic discipline.

• 
Employment as part-time lecturer presupposes that teaching qualifications are included in the assessment of applicants for an external professor.

Other skills

• 
In addition to having a relevant master’s degree, emphasis is placed on your specialization and professional skills within the content of the respective courses.

• 
Good interpersonal and collaboration skills and the ability to contribute to a good working environment

• 
Teaching is mainly done in English. Proficiency in Danish will be helpful as some supervision opportunities may be in Danish. The conditions of employment and the qualification requirements are described further in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Terms of employment

Salary and employment will be in accordance with the Cirkulære om aftale om Eksterne lektorer ved universiteter m.fl. under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet. The maximum number of working hours per academic year is 500 and may vary as needed in individual semesters. Remuneration is based on the number of hours, which is determined twice a year.

When employed as a part-time lecturer you must take an introductory course on university teaching organised by CBS.

You will be assigned a researcher at the department as your professional contact person. You are expected to participate in professional events relevant to your teaching and you will also be part of the department’s network of part-time lecturers.

The recruitment process

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Further information

If you would like to know more about the position, please do not hesitate to contact Professor Karin Buhmann, email kbu.msc@cbs.dk.

Your application

To apply, click on the link “Apply online”, fill out the application form and attach the following documentation:

• 
Letter of motivation

• 
CV

• 
Diploma(s)

• 
Teaching Portfolio

• 
Publication list, if relevant for the position

Additional information about CBS and the department is available at www.cbs.dk.

Application due 11/3/2026

jobs.occupation: Dygtig og struktureret opvasker søges til Stubbs Gastronomi
jobs.description:

Hos Stubbs Gastronomi søger vi en engageret opvasker, der vil være med til at sikre, at vores køkken altid fremstår skinnende rent og velfungerende. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores dagligdag i et moderne køkken med gode faciliteter og stort fokus på trivsel.

Om jobbet

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

• 
Opvask af service, der tilbageleveres fra vores kunder

• 
Rengøring og opvask af køkkengrej og redskaber

• 
Generelle rengørings- og oprydningsopgaver i køkkenet

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• 
Trives med praktisk arbejde og sætter en ære i renlighed og orden

• 
Kan bevare overblikket og overholde strukturen i arbejdet

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og en god kollega

Hvad tilbyder vi?

• 
Arbejdstid: Hovedsageligt mandag til fredag i tidsrummet kl. 09.00 – 14.00 (der er plads til fleksibilitet).

• 
Vilkår: Tidslønnet stilling.

• 
Arbejdsplads: Et moderne køkken med gode faciliteter, en uformel omgangstone og fokus på god trivsel.

Har du lyst til at være en del af holdet?

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, eller har du spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os hurtigst muligt.

Send din ansøgning eller giv os et kald – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

We're looking for a Head Chef with a passion for food, culture, and community to join our team at Hobo Copenhagen. Opening in February 2027, you will shape our culinary identity and set the scene from day one. Are you a hands-on kitchen leader who thrives in dynamic environments, loves working alongside your team, and brings fresh, creative energy to work? Someone who crafts vibrant food experiences that bring people together? Then keep reading.

About Hobo

Yes, Hobo Copenhagen will be a lifestyle hotel. But more importantly, it will be a community. A place where we live, work, create, learn, and have fun together. A space for the curious, the social, and the young at heart. Since day one, with our sister hotels in Stockholm, Helsinki and Oslo, Hobo has been about more than rooms, it's about experiences, culture, and connection. With our vibrant restaurant, bar, event spaces, and local footprints, we will be constantly evolving. Always in beta. Always moving. We live by three core values: professional, passionate, and playful — and we expect the same from you.

About the role

As our Head Chef, you will lead all kitchen operations across Hobo Copenhagen, taking overall responsibility for our restaurant, all-day café, cocktail bar food, breakfast and conference. In a typical week, your time will center around dynamic, fully on-site shifts across all days of the week, with a heavy emphasis on leading service during peak evening and weekend periods (typically starting around 11:00 and running through to midnight). You’ll spend your days working directly on the pass alongside your team, mentoring chef’s, managing stewarding routines, managing the schedule, and handling ordering and inventory control. You’ll also balance daily service with weekly menu development sessions alongside the Bar & Restaurant Manager and F&B Manager, testing new seasonal ideas and sharing concepts that fit Hobo’s playful culture. Ultimately, you are here to build a cohesive, motivated kitchen team, run an efficient and food-safe kitchen, and establish a standout culinary reputation for Hobo Copenhagen while consistently meeting food cost and sustainability targets.

What you'll do

• 
Lead daily kitchen service with a strong hands-on presence, ensuring high culinary standards, consistency, and timely delivery across all outlets.

• 
Create and update seasonal menus, sharing dishes, and creative food initiatives that align with Hobo’s brand identity.

• 
Onboard, train, and coach kitchen colleagues and stewarding staff, fostering a respectful, positive, and supportive kitchen culture.

• 
Oversee staff scheduling, handle sick calls, manage ordering, stock rotation, and food cost controls to minimize waste.

• 
Maintain strict food safety and allergen standards, while supporting Hobo's sustainability practices such as waste sorting and resource management.

• 
Coordinate closely with the Bar & Restaurant Manager and F&B Manager to ensure smooth preparation, timing, and service flow.

Desired qualifications

• 
Relevant culinary training and proven experience leading a professional kitchen team.

• 
Strong culinary expertise with a background in developing seasonal menus, sharing concepts, and modern dining experiences.

• 
Solid grasp of kitchen administration, including staff scheduling, purchasing, stock management, and food cost control.

• 
In-depth knowledge of food safety, allergen management, and kitchen hygiene systems (e.g., e-smiley).

• 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• 
A people-focused leader who excels at communication, calm problem-solving under pressure, and team mentorship.

Bonus if you

• 
Are fluent or proficient in Danish or any of the Scandinavian languages.

• 
Have experience launching pop-up culinary concepts, chef collaborations, or high-volume lifestyle restaurant openings.

• 
Have prior experience using modern kitchen management and digital staff scheduling tools.

What we offer

As a full-time employee at Hobo Copenhagen, you are also a member of Strawberry and Nordic Hotels & Resorts, which gives you a lot of benefits.

• 
A creative playground where your ideas actually come to life.

• 
The chance to shape one of Copenhagen's most dynamic new hotel brands.

• 
A role where no two days are the same and you can leave your personal imprint.

• 
Four free nights at a hotel of your choice in our hotel chain per year.

• 
Staff prices in all chain restaurants and hotels (Strawberry).

Employment type

This position is a full-time position, the lead for the kitchen team and reporting to the F&B Manager, Gobo Hansen. Flexibility in scheduling is required, including availability for evenings and weekends depending on the activity.

Are we a match?

If you meet these requirements and are ready to create, connect, and curate the food scene at Hobo Copenhagen from the inside out, we'd love to hear from you.

Send us your CV. To help us get to know you, attach a cover letter, or even better, a short video telling us about yourself and your absolute favorite, hidden spot in Copenhagen.

Application deadline: 1st of November 2026.

Start date: January 2027.

For questions regarding the role, please reach out to F&B Manager, Gobo Hansen, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk. Please note that no applications will be accepted via email.

We review candidates continuously, so don't wait too long to apply!
